full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 47th Batch of Guiding Cases

Fa [2025] No. 150

The High People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon deliberation and decision by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, the following six cases, including A Technology Co., Ltd. v. A Cultural Media Co., Ltd. — dispute over unfair competition (Guiding Cases No. 262–267), are hereby issued as the 47th batch of Guiding Cases for reference in adjudicating similar cases.

August 27, 2025
